qualification_status_semantics.task_flags: ready, framework_qualified and trusted_retest_qualified describe only the completed scoped qualification in that row; they do not qualify arbitrary later checkouts or changed candidates.
qualification_status_semantics.framework_qualified: The framework evidence component is accepted for the named scope and execution commit; individual framework-only results remain separately documented.
qualification_status_semantics.trusted_retest_qualified: Completed trusted evidence is accepted at its original execution commit under the linked compatibility review; this does not claim a new trusted retest at the compatible checkout.
qualification_status_semantics.global_flags: Top-level ready, refresh_scope qualification_claimed and consolidation current_qualification_claimed concern the complete 23-task branch.
qualification_status_semantics.qualification_counts: unfinished_task_count counts tasks without an approved scoped qualification. tasks_without_historical_ready_receipt_count preserves the separate consolidation count of tasks without a historical ready-subset receipt.
